changes.title: Trump-Backed Rep. Andy Biggs Wins Arizona Governor Primary
changes.summary: Arizona Rep. Andy Biggs was the runaway winner of the Republican primary in the governor’s race. That sets up a matchup this fall with Democratic Gov. Katie Hobbs. Biggs, who was endorsed by President Donald Trump, held a consistent lead in the polls leading up to the vote.
